messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for inference-embed-queue (pd-12345) — Sev 2 — Impacting hosted inference (eu-west-1). https://pagerduty.example.com/incidents/pd-12345
PagerDuty: Alert: p95 latency > 1.8s for 2m on embedder-eu. Auto-escalation in 3m.
Alex W: I'm on it, claiming the page.
Maya R: Thanks — can you confirm whether this is customer-facing errors or just latency?
Alex W: Initial triage: increased queue length on embedder pool eu-west-1, 5xxs look normal. Seems like backpressure -> higher tail latency.
Drew S: Can you paste a couple lines of logs from the worker?
Alex W: logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:01:23Z embed-worker-3 WARN queue_wait_ms=1200 qlen=45
2026-03-15T09:01:25Z proxy-2 INFO request_proxy latency_ms=1860
```
Maya R: @Carol (CS) heads up — we've started seeing slower search responses in EU, no hard errors reported by customers yet.
Carol (CS): Got 2 tickets inbound, flagged as low severity but impacting perceived performance for one customer.
Samir: Any HPA/autoscaler activity? Could be warmup not triggering.
Alex W: HPA didn't scale — CPU utilization low, but queue backlog high. Suspect metric mismatch (we use queue length metric downstream).
Drew S: Manual scale to try immediate mitigation: bump replicas +4.
Alex W: Doing manual scale: `kubectl scale deploy embedder-eu --replicas=6` :thumbsup:
incident-bot: action executed: manual scale request issued by Alex W
PagerDuty: Acknowledged by Alex W
Maya R: Please ping when qlen < 10 or p95 < 500ms.
Alex W: Scale applied. qlen -> 8 after ~40s, p95 -> ~420ms.
Carol (CS): I'll message affected customers: "We've applied emergency capacity; latency is returning to normal. Monitoring continues."
Drew S: We'll capture HPA logs and watch for why autoscaler didn't kick. Filing follow-up ticket `RM-4567` for investigation and runbook update.
Alex W: I'll hand this to Drew for postmortem in 20m. @Drew S please take ownership after I step off.
Drew S: Taking ownership for RCA and runbook updates.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident pd-12345 status changed to mitigated (auto-mitigated by manual action).
Maya R: Great work, team. :tada:
Carol (CS): Updating customer notes and closing tickets if no further regressions.
Drew S: Will post RCA draft in #postmortems and link to runbook changes.
Maya R: Closing thread for now — follow-up in postmortem.
